why: A royal fork: the check comes first, the free piece comes next.
whyLong: Check plus attack is the strongest fork there is. Here it wins his rook. Glitch wanted you busy eating the horse.

whyTargets.prompt: Tap the king and the rook your horse hits.

glitch.taunt: Mmm, horse. Crunchy. Grab it quick!
glitch.gloat: No check, no fork, no chance. Lovely.
glitch.rage: The KING and the rook?! Rude! So rude!

short: Check and bite. Collect next move.

title: Run or Lose
hook: His big piece is shielding a friend.
why: Hit the front piece. When it steps away, take the back one.
whyLong: When the king steps off the line, your bishop eats the horse. That check looked scary and did nothing.

whyTargets.prompt: Tap the king that must run and the horse behind.

glitch.taunt: Straight lines are boring. Try a zigzag.
glitch.gloat: Both my pieces say thank you.
glitch.rage: Through the middle?! That's a shish kebab!

short: Poke the front. Take the back.

title: Crown Run
hook: Push the right pawn and he can't keep up.
why: Your pawn is closer to the end than his defenders are.
whyLong: A pawn one step from a crown is worth more than most pieces. That check looked scary and did nothing.

whyTargets.prompt: Tap the pawn that wants a crown.

glitch.taunt: Just check him. Checks never lose. Trust me.
glitch.gloat: You checked. I moved. We can do this all day.
glitch.rage: NOOOO. It reached the end! Who let it?!

short: Push. His guards are too far.

title: Trap Door
hook: Take away his piece's last escape.
why: It cannot run anywhere. Hit it and collect.
whyLong: A piece with no squares is already lost. Attack it and wait. Glitch wanted you busy eating the pawn.

whyTargets.prompt: Tap the queen with no way out.

glitch.taunt: Look at that juicy pawn. Just take it!
glitch.gloat: The cage was open. I noticed.
glitch.rage: Every door is locked?! Who has the key?!

title: Queen Me
hook: The last row is closer than it looks.
why: The pawn runs, and his pieces are too far to catch it.
whyLong: Passed pawns must be pushed. His pieces are too far away to stop it. Glitch wanted you to play it safe.

whyTargets.prompt: Tap the pawn that wants a crown.

glitch.taunt: Play it safe. Your king wants a little walk.
glitch.gloat: Slow and safe. And now I win. Ha!
glitch.rage: Stop it! Pawns are not allowed to grow up!

short: The pawn runs. Nobody catches it.

title: Counterpunch
hook: His attack left something open.
why: Hit back harder, and his attack no longer matters.
whyLong: Before you run, look for checks and captures of your own. The free queen was a trap.

whyTargets.prompt: Tap his queen and the queen it attacks.

glitch.taunt: Free queen! Free queen! Take it before I change my mind!
glitch.gloat: You ran. My piece is fine. Thanks for playing.
glitch.rage: You didn't RUN?! Everybody runs!

short: Hit back harder. His attack fades.
